name: cc-retro-deck-windows
description: Windows (Windows Terminal, PowerShell): C64 footer and header band, a deck of every running Claude session with jumps between Windows Terminal tabs, LOAD "*",8,1 with boot screen, a dancing crab.

theme.description: Color palette: c64 (all 16 VIC-II colors, light blue ground), amiga (Workbench 1.3) or cga (IBM 16 colors)
theme.title: Theme

header.title: C64 header above the prompt
header.description: Keep the header (logo, star sky, two crabs hand in hand) and the boot banner above the prompt, as the tmux frame shows them on macOS and Linux

autoSwitch.description: Bring this session's Windows Terminal tab to the front when it needs you, but only while the tab you are looking at is busy working
autoSwitch.title: Auto-switch to the tab that needs you

autoOpen.description: Open the deck pane when the session starts (seats only from 144 columns; /deck opens it at any width)
autoOpen.title: Open the deck at session start

banner.title: Brand banner at session start
banner.description: Show the retro boot banner above the prompt for the first seconds of a session

crab.title: Dancing crab at session start
crab.description: Let the Claude Code crab, at its own size, walk and dance across the band for the first seconds of a session

introEvery.title: Crab comes back every (seconds)
introEvery.description: Replay the crab and banner intro every so many seconds while nothing waits for you; 0 turns the replay off
